stem:
Neel notices cactus in a dry yard and ferns near a wet wall.

Why do the plants differ in the two places?

options.text: They differ only because someone painted the walls different colours.
Different conditions (water, heat, soil) support different plants.
Every region must have the same plants.
Plants cannot differ; only animals can.

teacher.key_rationale: Living things in a region match the conditions there. Colour of paint is not the cause. Regions need not match.
